problem.title: Budget Optimizer
problem.statement: You have projects with different profits. Choose projects to maximize profit, but you cannot pick two adjacent projects (conflict of interest). Find the maximum profit.
problem.hint: At each project, you have two choices: take it or skip it. If you take it, the previous project must be skipped. If you skip, take the best from before.
problem.walkthrough:
Example profit: [5, 10, 8, 3, 7, 4].

Project 1 (5): take=5, skip=0
Project 2 (10): take=0+10=10, skip=max(5,0)=5
Project 3 (8): take=5+8=13, skip=max(10,5)=10
Project 4 (3): take=10+3=13, skip=max(13,10)=13
Project 5 (7): take=13+7=20, skip=max(13,13)=13
Project 6 (4): take=13+4=17, skip=max(20,13)=20

Answer: max(17, 20) = 20.

Key insight: at each step, compute two values: profit if this project is taken and if it is skipped.
